snippet.title: He is Coming - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer | IGN Live 2025
snippet.description: Get a fresh look at He is Coming in this trailer for the upcoming roguelite RPG auto battler game where you explore a procedurally generated fantasy kingdom, collect magical trinkets, and prepare for the arrival of The Big Bad. The new He is Coming trailer shows gameplay and its retro-style world. He is Coming will be available in Steam Early Access on July 17, 2025.
